title: anthyllis vulneraria subsp. nivalis
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. nivalis, commonly known as Snowy Marjoram, is a subspecies of the greater knapweed plant, known for its white or pinkish flowers and astringent properties. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, wounds, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Snowy Marjoram include its ability to act as an anti-diarrheal, astringent, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
